title: Pomegranate: modeled ₹2,217/qtl left, Kathua → Hamirpur (Nadaun)
summary: January 2021: reported pomegranate prices at Kathua and Hamirpur (Nadaun) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 25 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹2,217 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 116 same-variety market pairs screened for pomegranate in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Hamirpur (Nadaun) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Kathua (Jammu and Kashmir) and Hamirpur (Nadaun) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported pomegranate prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 25 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kathua reported a median ₹8,500 per quintal. Hamirpur (Nadaun) reported a median ₹12,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹3,500/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹3,500 per quintal, and Hamirpur (Nadaun) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 182 km by road
scenes.caption: 182 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹39/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹2,352 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹1,713 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Hamirpur (Nadaun) report, the rule selects 24 of 24 modeled shipping days. 24 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹2,217 per quintal (₹1,598 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pomegranate route from Kathua to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹221,700, or ₹159,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pomegranate
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹39/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pomegranate route from Kathua to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹221,700, or ₹159,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
